content:
**Brown House** is a location in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Skyline Valley* update.

The Brown House is the presidential residence located at Rapidan Camp. It was first used by Herbert Hoover and his wife Lou. It was named after its color to match the name of the White House. [1] 

| Image | Name | Description | 
| ![Brown House Plaque.jpg](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/4/42/Brown_House_Plaque.jpg/180px-Brown_House_Plaque.jpg) | Brown House Information Plaque | Welcome to the Brown House; it was the home of President Hoover and his wife Lou while they stayed at Rapidan Camp. The house gets its name from the color, like how our Presidents live at the White House, it was only fitting to name their summer home after the house color. | 

During the Public Test Server, there was an inaccessible bunker containing references to Raven Rock and the Poseidon Oil Rig, as well as multiple skeletons, past a blocked door in the House's basement. This bunker was removed when the update released.

Brown House appears in *Fallout 76*.
